Description: Two softened complex Möbius transforms fold clone coordinates through a rotating hyperbolic portal, exposing poles as controlled infinities instead of editor-killing singularities.
KScript: var phase := t*v1+u*v2; var zx := x*v0; var zy := y*v0; var a := cos(phase); var b := sin(phase); var nr := zx+a; var ni := zy+b; var dr := 1.0+a*zx-b*zy; var di := a*zy+b*zx; var d2 := max(dr*dr+di*di+v3,0.001); zx := (nr*dr+ni*di)/d2; zy := (ni*dr-nr*di)/d2; var phase2 := phase*1.618+t*v1*0.37; a := cos(phase2); b := sin(phase2); nr := zx+a; ni := zy+b; dr := 1.0+a*zx-b*zy; di := a*zy+b*zx; d2 := max(dr*dr+di*di+v3,0.001); zx := (nr*dr+ni*di)/d2; zy := (ni*dr-nr*di)/d2; var warp := exp(-(zx*zx+zy*zy)*v6); x += (zx*v4-x)*v5; y += (zy*v4-y)*v5; z += sin(phase2)*warp*v7; rz += (zx-zy)*v8;

Variables.Name: CoordinateScale
Variables.Tooltip: Maps world space into the complex plane

Variables.Name: PoleSoftening
Variables.Tooltip: Prevents a transform pole from exploding
